name: standing
hint: upright on their feet — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: sitting
hint: seated — on a chair, bench, ledge, or the ground — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: crouching
hint: crouched, hunched over, bent forward over something, down on the balls of the feet — prefer 'kneeling' if they are upright on both knees — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: lying
hint: lying down flat on their back — asleep, collapsed, on a bed or the ground — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: kneeling
hint: upright on both knees, torso vertical — praying, proposing, tending to someone on the floor; prefer 'crouching' if they are bent forward over something — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: sitting-ground
hint: sitting on the floor or ground with the legs straight out in front, torso upright — use this rather than 'sitting' when there is no chair, and rather than 'lying' when they are upright — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: leaning-back
hint: standing with the weight tipped back and the chin up — leaning against a wall, bar or desk edge, or looking upward — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: head-down
hint: standing with the head bowed and the hands raised to meet the eyeline — reading, checking a phone or a map, studying something held — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: slumped
hint: standing but collapsed forward through the spine and neck, legs nearly straight — exhausted, defeated, grieving; prefer 'crouching' if they are down on bent knees — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: arms-raised
hint: standing with both arms up overhead — surrender, hands up, cheering, reaching for something high, waving to someone far off — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: walking
hint: mid-stride, walking or running — legs in opposition, arms counter-swung; use when the character is moving rather than standing still — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: pointing
hint: one arm raised out and forward to point at something, the other arm down, head following the point — indicating, directing, singling something out — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: looking-off
hint: standing square on but with the head turned away to look off to one side — distracted, hearing something, watching something leave frame — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: turned-to-listen
hint: turned toward someone standing beside or behind them, torso round and head further — listening, being addressed, in conversation — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: gesturing
hint: mid-speech with one hand open and raised, the other arm quiet — talking, explaining, making a point — use this when the description does not indicate a woman

name: standing-female
hint: upright on their feet, female figure — use when the description indicates a woman
